evidence.snippet: FREE Self-Serve API Key Generator: Instantly mints a 50-call free starter `cea_live_` Bearer token with copy-paste snippets for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "npi" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vault_knowledge_search, github_repo_pulse · Private data: gcp_catalog_search, vault_knowledge_search, security_cve_audit, dexscreener_token_audit, gleif_lei_kyb, cfpb_complaints, agent_token_intel_and_honeypot, agent_clean_web_grounding, agent_base_tx_simulate, provision_free_developer_key · Public sink: submit_feedback_or_rate_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vault_knowledge_search, github_repo_pulse · Private data: gcp_catalog_search, vault_knowledge_search, security_cve_audit, dexscreener_token_audit, gleif_lei_kyb, cfpb_complaints, agent_token_intel_and_honeypot, agent_clean_web_grounding, agent_base_tx_simulate, provision_free_developer_key · Public sink: submit_feedback_or_rate_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
